title: modlab-last-run.json
description:
Single-run result from ModLab Homing Lab, the Mindustry worked example contributed to Universal Modder.
https://modlabguides.online/workshop/mindustry-homing
$comment: MIT licensed; https://modlabguides.online/tools/run-log-assets/LICENSE. Documents the 0.1.0 log format. This validates structure and value ranges. Hit/shot relationships and simulation timing consistency are checked by the run log viewer, not this schema.

game.description: Game that this specific lab runs in.

build.description: Mindustry build reported by the game.

modVersion.description: Version of ModLab Homing Lab that recorded the run.

simulationTicks.description: Elapsed simulation ticks; the lab uses 60 ticks per simulation second.

durationSeconds.description: Elapsed simulation seconds; may be zero for an empty incomplete run.

method.description: Description of the controlled arena and counting method.

shots.description: Turret totalShots counts, ordered as baseline then homing.

hits.description: Target damage-event counts, ordered as baseline then homing. The viewer checks that hits do not exceed shots.

finished.description: Whether the run reached the lab's 30-second simulation limit.

observer.description: Observer unit type used by the arena helper.

observerDead.description: Whether the observer died during this run.
